messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] designing survey
parts:
Banya

I'll not create a video regarding data entry for recce surveys at the moment.  It is actually a complicated analysis requiring two passes through the data.

The first pass uses data from recce effort (stratum label "recce") as well as planned survey effort (stratum label "planned") to compute encounter rate and variability in encounter rates.  The second pass uses only detections from the planned survey effort (accomplished via a data filter on stratum type) to fit a detection function.  The secret to performing the multi-pass analysis is using stratum labels to identify the types of survey effort so the data filter can operate.  If you consult the paper by Walsh and White (1999), they suggest the detections made by recce effort might need to be calibrated with planned effort because observer rate of travel on recce effort might be much greater than on planned transects.

Walsh, P. D., and L. J. T. White. 1999. What it will take to monitor forest elephant populations. Conservation Biology 13:1194–1202.

The results of the two passes are then combined (along with their measures of precision) to produce density estimates.  Encounter rate (and its precision) coming from analysis pass 1 (using both types of effort) along with detection function parameter estimates (f_0 and precision) from analysis pass 2.  Uncertainty is propagated using the delta method (squared CV of density is sum of squared CVs of encounter rate, f_0 and group size).

Perhaps we could correspond off-list about your data organisation; feel free to write to my personal email address.  You could then report a summary of what we discussed back to the list.

Regarding the use of the survey design engine, I recommend you view the lectures and exercises on survey design found in Chapter 4 of our online distance sampling training:

https://workshops.distancesampling.org/online-course/syllabus/Chapter4/
Please can record a simple tutorial on how to import or make data entry of recce survey in the distance app and design a particular survey design. Thank you.
